label: ID card
intent: The card is read and the holder's details fill in. Light: the photo pops as the identity is captured, then the first detail line writes out to full length and the second follows a beat later; the details stay. Strong: the card taps down onto a reader and springs back, the photo pops harder, and the two lines write out in turn, each stopping crisply at full length. The preview reset fades the details back to their stubs.

card.//: Solid: the details are the one moving knockout (a fade reset allows one); the photo's hole is a fixed cut of its rest disc, as in v1

details.//: two 2-unit stubs at rest (prepared) that write out to v1's 8-unit lines, each on its own driver

card.//: the whole card taps in Strong

reverse.//: the preview reset fades only the details; the card and the photo end at rest, so they stay
